content:textarea:1787236989228:0.3802364.html: Thank you for your interest in volunteering with The Salvation Army of Augusta! Whether you're looking to serve as an individual, family, group, or organization, we'd love to help you find the right opportunity. Before creating a volunteer account, please contact our Volunteer Coordinator, Kristin Cordaro, to discuss current volunteer needs and available opportunities. Call: (706)922-8382  Email: Kristin.Cordaro@uss.salvationarmy.org

content:wysiwyg_basic:6:14.html:
Mandated community service

Once your application is approved, you will receive a confirmation e-mail prompting you to log in to your profile and schedule your shifts. Walk-ins Are only accepted at the Thomson Thrift Store.

There are a limited number of openings for each shift and all spots are available on a first-come, first-serve basis. Community Service Workers must be 18 or older.
